import re

PID = re.compile(r"^(?P<pid>\d+):\s*$")
TOTAL = re.compile(r"^Total Usage - (?P<loaders>\d+) loaders, (?P<classes>\d+) classes \((?P<shared>\d+) shared\):\s*$")
USAGE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<space>[\w-]+):\s+(?P<chunks>\d+) chunks,\s+(?P<capacity>[\d.]+ \w+) capacity,\s+(?P<committed>[\d.]+ \w+) \(\s*(?P<committed_pct><?\d+%)\) committed,\s+(?P<used>[\d.]+ \w+) \(\s*(?P<used_pct><?\d+%)\) used,\s+(?P<free>[\d.]+ \w+) \(\s*(?P<free_pct><?\d+%)\) free,\s+(?P<waste>[\d.]+ \w+) \(\s*(?P<waste_pct><?\d+%)\) waste\s?, deallocated: (?P<dealloc_blocks>\d+) blocks with (?P<dealloc>[\d.]+ \w+)\s*$")
VSPACE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<space>[\w-]+(?: space)?):\s+(?P<reserved>[\d.]+ \w+) reserved,\s+(?P<committed>[\d.]+ \w+) \(\s*(?P<committed_pct><?\d+%)\) committed(?:,\s+(?P<nodes>\d+) nodes)?\.\s*$")
FREELIST = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<size>\d+[kmgKMG]):\s+(?:\(none\)|(?P<count>\d+), capacity=(?P<capacity>[\d.]+ \w+), committed=(?P<committed>[\d.]+ \w+) \(\s*(?P<committed_pct><?\d+%)\))\s*$")
FREETOTAL = re.compile(r"^Total word size: (?P<total>[\d.]+ \w+), committed: (?P<committed>[\d.]+ \w+) \(\s*(?P<committed_pct><?\d+%)\)\s*$")
WASTE_HDR = re.compile(r"^Waste \(unused committed space\):\s*\(percentages refer to total committed size (?P<total>[\d.]+ \w+)\):\s*$")
WASTE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<item>[\w-][\w -]*?):\s+(?P<size>[\d.]+ \w+) \(\s*(?P<pct><?\d+%)\)(?: \((?P<blocks>\d+) blocks\))?\s*$")
POOL = re.compile(r"^chunk header pool: (?P<items>\d+) items, (?P<size>[\d.]+ \w+)\.\s*$")
STAT = re.compile(r"^(?P<key>\w+): (?P<value>\d+)\.\s*$")
SETTING = re.compile(r"^(?:\s*- )?(?P<key>\w[\w ]*?): (?P<value>\S.*?)\.?\s*$")
TITLE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<title>[A-Za-z][\w -]*):\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    summary, usage, vspace, free, freetotals, waste, stats, settings = {}, [], [], [], [], [], {}, {}
    used = {k: [] for k in ("summary", "usage", "vspace", "free", "freetotals", "waste", "pool", "stats", "settings")}
    pool, skip = {}, []
    section, space = "", ""
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = PID.match(ln)
        if m:
            summary["pid"] = m.group("pid")
            used["summary"].append(j)
            continue
        m = TOTAL.match(ln)
        if m:
            summary["loaders"] = m.group("loaders")
            summary["classes"] = m.group("classes")
            summary["shared classes"] = m.group("shared")
            used["summary"].append(j)
            section = "usage"
            continue
        m = WASTE_HDR.match(ln)
        if m:
            summary["total committed size"] = m.group("total")
            used["summary"].append(j)
            section = "waste"
            continue
        m = POOL.match(ln)
        if m:
            pool = {"items": m.group("items"), "size": m.group("size")}
            used["pool"].append(j)
            continue
        m = TITLE.match(ln)
        if m:
            title = m.group("title")
            if section == "freelists":
                # the sub-title names the space whose freelist follows
                space = title.strip()
                used["free"].append(j)
                continue
            sec = {"Virtual space": "vspace", "Chunk freelists": "free",
                   "Internal statistics": "stats", "Settings": "settings"}.get(title)
            if sec:
                section = sec
                used[sec].append(j)
            else:
                skip.append(j)
            continue
        if section == "usage":
            m = USAGE.match(ln)
            if m:
                usage.append({"space": m.group("space"), "chunks": m.group("chunks"), "capacity": m.group("capacity"),
                              "committed": m.group("committed"), "committed %": m.group("committed_pct"),
                              "used": m.group("used"), "used %": m.group("used_pct"),
                              "free": m.group("free"), "free %": m.group("free_pct"),
                              "waste": m.group("waste"), "waste %": m.group("waste_pct"),
                              "deallocated blocks": m.group("dealloc_blocks"), "deallocated": m.group("dealloc")})
                used["usage"].append(j)
        elif section == "vspace":
            m = VSPACE.match(ln)
            if m:
                vspace.append({"space": m.group("space"), "reserved": m.group("reserved"),
                               "committed": m.group("committed"), "committed %": m.group("committed_pct"),
                               "nodes": m.group("nodes") or ""})
                used["vspace"].append(j)
        elif section == "free":
            m = FREELIST.match(ln)
            if m:
                free.append({"space": space, "chunk size": m.group("size"), "count": m.group("count") or "0",
                             "capacity": m.group("capacity") or "", "committed": m.group("committed") or "",
                             "committed %": m.group("committed_pct") or ""})
                used["free"].append(j)
                continue
            m = FREETOTAL.match(ln)
            if m:
                freetotals.append({"space": space, "total word size": m.group("total"),
                                   "committed": m.group("committed"), "committed %": m.group("committed_pct")})
                used["freetotals"].append(j)
        elif section == "waste":
            m = WASTE.match(ln)
            if m:
                waste.append({"item": m.group("item"), "size": m.group("size"), "%": m.group("pct"),
                              "blocks": m.group("blocks") or ""})
                used["waste"].append(j)
        elif section == "stats":
            m = STAT.match(ln)
            if m:
                stats[m.group("key")] = m.group("value")
                used["stats"].append(j)
        elif section == "settings":
            m = SETTING.match(ln)
            if m:
                settings[m.group("key")] = m.group("value")
                used["settings"].append(j)
    return {"blocks": [
        {"name": "summary", "kind": "kv", "lines": used["summary"], "records": [summary] if summary else []},
        {"name": "usage", "kind": "table", "lines": used["usage"], "records": usage},
        {"name": "virtual space", "kind": "table", "lines": used["vspace"], "records": vspace},
        {"name": "chunk freelists", "kind": "table", "lines": used["free"], "records": free},
        {"name": "chunk freelist totals", "kind": "table", "lines": used["freetotals"], "records": freetotals},
        {"name": "waste", "kind": "table", "lines": used["waste"], "records": waste},
        {"name": "chunk header pool", "kind": "kv", "lines": used["pool"], "records": [pool] if pool else []},
        {"name": "internal statistics", "kind": "kv", "lines": used["stats"], "records": [stats] if stats else []},
        {"name": "settings", "kind": "kv", "lines": used["settings"], "records": [settings] if settings else []}],
        "skip": skip}
